violations.description: THAWING POTENTIALLY HAZARDOUS FOOD (2 pts): Potentially hazardous foods noted not being thawed using approved methods. Fish thawing without original packaging being opened to allow atmospheric air to be let into the packaging.
STORAGE/HANDLING CLEAN EQUIP & UTENSILS (1 pts): Clean Utensils noted stored in a drawer with other non-sanitary items near the prep area in the kitchen.

IN-USE UTENSILS (1 pts): In - use utensil noted being stored with the handle laying in the following but not limited to flour sugar and cole slaw. In use utensils were noted being stored or contacting unclean surfaces. Food tongs being stored on handles of equipment where the door surface and the wall it comes in contact with when door is opened is not a sanitary surface to store clean utensils.
FLOORS WALLS CEILINGS (1 pts): Floors in the kitchen are slippery and should be cleaned more frequently.
CROSS CONTAMINATION (5 pts): Raw meat noted being stored above food not to be further cooked. Observed whole muscle beef stored above vegetables in the drawer style cooler below the char broiler.
HANDWASHING LAVATORIES AND SUPPLIES (3 pts): Hand washing lavatory in kitchen at the end of the cook line noted blocked with portable cooler and boxes.
CONTAMINATION FROM WIPING CLOTHS (2 pts): Wiping cloths noted not stored in adequate sanitizing solution. Quat spray bottles in expo station and in bar tested at 0 PPM.
SINGLE - USE/SINGLE - SERVICE ARTICLES (1 pts): Cases of to-go containers noted being stored on the floor in the expo area.
